C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 714
Date 15/11/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 14th 1926.

Sir,
A memorial service in honour of Daung Chi
Sung 唐继尧 Chuh Ling Sz 褚民谊 and others Shanghai
rebels who were executed while Yuan Shih Kai
was President was held in Gheong Woo Dan 共舞台
theatre near the West Gate on 13th inst.
There were about 200 persons present. The
function was presided over by Tsang Woo 章武
Pah Vung Wei 柏文蔚 Daung Jien Kyung 唐继钦 and
three others all of whom are prominent in rebel
circles. Messrs. Sun Yat Sen, Tang Shao Yi,
Yang Tcheng and Zee Koh Liang were represented by
delegates. Speeches were made praising the work
of the dead heroes. The meeting was non-political
and was orderly throughout. There were no
pamphlets distributed at the meeting. The names and
other particulars of the deceased were written on
scrolls which were hung up on the walls of the
building.
The distribution of passage tickets was continued at General
Li Tsing Woo's 李徵五 house on 13th inst when about
108 rebels were supplied with such tickets.
The Committee of the Painters Guild in Park Road
have summoned the workers to a meeting to be
held in the guild house at 2 p.m. to-day when it
is reported proposals for another strike will be
discussed.
General Yang has sent one of his staff officers
named Zou Li Wang 赵正模 to Nanking to make arrangements
to have the 10th division at present at Woosung sent
to the North.
It is reported that the friends of Li Ping
Shu are trying to get him appointed Director of
the Kiangnan Arsenal.

Your Obedient servant,
McNewman -
Detective Sub-Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Endorsed m.m.d Nov. 14.）

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 714 号
日期 1926年11月15日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1926年11月14日。

先生：
为纪念唐继尧、褚民谊及其他在袁世凯任总统期间被处决的上海反叛者举行的追悼会，于本月13日在西门附近的共舞台剧院举行。
出席者约200人。会议由章武、柏文蔚、唐继钦及另外三人主持，此四人在反叛圈子中均颇具影响力。孙中山、唐绍仪、杨澄（音译）及李烈钧的代表出席了会议。会上发表了颂扬已故英雄功绩的演讲。会议非政治性，全程秩序井然。会上未分发任何传单。逝者的姓名及其他详情写在卷轴上，悬挂于建筑物墙壁上。
本月13日，在李徵五将军寓所继续分发船票，约有108名反叛分子领取了此类船票。
派克路画家公会委员会已召集工人于今日下午2时在公会会所举行会议，据报将讨论再次罢工的提议。
杨将军已派遣其一名名为赵正模的参谋军官前往南京，安排将目前位于吴淞的第十师调往北方。
据报，李平书的朋友正试图谋求任命他为江南制造局总监。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克纽曼 -
侦探副督察。

警察总巡官。

（批注：11月14日背书 m.m.d.）

Shanghai Municipal Police.
                                            Sinza            Station.
                                         November II th      1916.

REPORT ON    Distribution of Steamer Tickets.

Made by    Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Lines.

                                Sir,
                    Between II a.m. & 4 p.m. on the II th.
instant at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII General Lee Tsun WOO 李衛五
handed a Steamer Ticket to each of 735 Revolutionary Ex.
Soldiers who have already agreed to leave Shanghai.
        Further Tickets will issued on 13 th inst.

                                        yours obediently,
                                        Lawrence Fitzgibbon -
                                                Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.

                                         1916年11月11日

关于    轮船票分发情况的报告。

由    侦探督察菲茨吉本制作。    由林斯督察转呈。

                                先生：
                    本月11日上午11时至下午4时之间，在爱多亚路367/8号，李卫五将军向735名已同意离开上海的革命退伍士兵每人分发了一张轮船票。
        更多船票将于本月13日发放。

                                        您顺从的仆人，
                                        劳伦斯·菲茨吉本 -
                                                侦探督察。
首席侦探督察。

have already agreed to leave Shanghai.
